adequate.basis: 256 simple Int leaves, 256 String-identity callbacks, at most 64 bytes per key, 256 dictionary collision lookups, a bounded 256-entry sort and one final immutable result. No data-dependent loop or geometry beyond one box. This is a conservative finite-fixture allowance, not an exact charge count.
